name: xcode
description: Read official stable and beta Xcode release notes and safely launch Apple's native headless Xcode MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read stable and beta Xcode updates and launch its native MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Xcode bundles a What's New skill for official Apple stable and beta release notes and an MCP skill for safely launching the Xcode-provided headless server on attended Macs, unattended hosts, and explicitly isolated CI machines.
defaultPrompt: Use $xcode:whats-new to show what's new in my active Xcode.
Use $xcode:mcp to launch Apple's native Xcode MCP server safely.
